newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to start casino concession process next wk.
newsitem.headline: Panama to start casino concession process next wk.

text.p: Panama plans to announce the pre-qualification dates to operate its 20 casinos next week, a high-ranking government official said Tuesday.

The government hopes to announce the conditions for the pre-qualification process next week in order to announce those eligible to bid by the end of the year, Alfredo Macia, head of Panama's privatization program, told Reuters Tuesday.
The casinos are in hotels throughout Panama City and Colon, some 50 miles (80 km) from Panama City on the Atlantic coast, Macia said.
Annual casino revenues hover around $7 million and the government hopes to double or triple that amount when foreign companies take over operations, he said.
"We want the foreign investors to refurbish the facilities and replace old machines. We don't have the flexibility to do that," he said.
Panama's constitution prohibits the sale of the casinos, but foreign companies can operate them.
